name: CeraVe Resurfacing Retinol Serum 30ml | Post-Acne Marks, Brightening & Pore Minimizer
description:
CeraVe Resurfacing Retinol Serum is a dermatologist-developed formula designed to reduce post-acne marks, minimize pores, and improve overall skin texture. Enriched with encapsulated retinol, Niacinamide, Licorice Root Extract, and Ceramides, it brightens the complexion, restores the skin barrier, and supports smooth, healthy-looking skin. Lightweight, non-comedogenic, and fragrance-free, this 30ml serum is suitable for daily use on all skin types.
Key Features
 Reduces appearance of post-acne marks and blemishes
 Minimizes pores and improves skin smoothness
 Encapsulated retinol resurfaces skin texture effectively
 Licorice root extract brightens and evens skin tone
 Niacinamide soothes and calms irritated skin
 Ceramides restore and maintain natural skin barrier
How to Use
 Apply a small amount to clean, dry face
 Massage gently until fully absorbed
 Use 1–2 times daily, preferably at night
 Follow with moisturizer for best results
Material
Encapsulated Retinol, Niacinamide, Licorice Root Extract, Ceramides, serum base
Safety Information
 For external use only
 Avoid contact with eyes
 Keep out of reach of children
 Do not use on broken or irritated skin
 Discontinue if irritation occurs
Package Includes
 1 × 30ml CeraVe Resurfacing Retinol Serum
